implementation_choices.centered_target_basis: Use one fixed QR-orthonormal basis for the seven-dimensional subspace orthogonal to the all-ones vector. This is an algebraically exact coordinate system for the registered raw centered target, not a learned projection.
implementation_choices.large_regression: Use the registered full functional-state matrix in float32 on GPU. Compute the full-state ridge solution in the dual over training transitions by Cholesky factorization.
implementation_choices.supervised_projection: SVD is applied only to the full oracle's fitted training contribution in the exact seven-dimensional centered output basis. Rank seven must reconstruct the full-P prediction to maximum absolute error at most 1e-5.
implementation_choices.remote_evaluation: Natural and LOO branches both use their own frozen neural s_t and functional P_t as teacher-forced inputs. Predicted updates are cumulatively summed from the observed branch s_0; no predicted state is fed back.
implementation_choices.memory: Process one backbone at a time, keep raw functional-state trajectories only in memory, release them before the next backbone, and save only coefficients and aggregate results.
